topic.bc02-come-killer.speaker: hides-in-reeds
topic.bc02-come-killer.prompt: Come with me. I will get you out.
lines: I will follow. I killed. I do not deny it. The heirs hold me for it. Two others are bound here in the smoke, Says-It-Plain and Keeps-The-Old-Count. The way out is the way you came in.

topic.bc02-come-mother.speaker: keeps-the-old-count
topic.bc02-come-mother.prompt: Come with me. I will get you out.
lines: Yes. I will follow you. The heirs hold me for what they reckon I owe. Two others are bound here in the smoke, Says-It-Plain and Hides-In-Reeds. Go back the way you came in.

topic.bc02-the-fire.speaker: never-sold
lines: The heirs' outer post, the old keep above Blackrose, is burning. How it started is not known. Three are bound inside. Says-It-Plain is held for speaking against the heirs. Hides-In-Reeds is held for a killing. Keeps-The-Old-Count, Rows-For-Another's mother, is working off what the heirs reckon she owes. Third-Born Tsaxi keeps the way in.

topic.bc02-come-speaker.speaker: says-it-plain
topic.bc02-come-speaker.prompt: Come with me. I will get you out.
lines: I will follow you. Three of us are bound in this keep, in the smoke: myself, Hides-In-Reeds and Keeps-The-Old-Count. Go. The way out is the way you came in. Remember that I spoke against the heirs.

topic.bc02-the-gate.speaker: third-born-tsaxi
lines: Your words hold. Go in. The heirs will not go in after you. The way out will bear one trip. One will come out. Whoever is left inside, the fire takes. Choose well.
fail: No. I keep the way in. Your words do not move me yet. Find better words, or go back down the hill.

topic.bc02-let-by.speaker: third-born-tsaxi
lines: Go by. The heirs lost nothing worth entering the keep to fetch. The way out will bear one trip. You have used it. Whoever is left inside, the fire takes.
fail: No. I keep the way. This one does not go by. Your words do not move me yet. Find better words.
